name: hermes
install: git clone --branch v2026.9.24 <repo> /opt/harness/src && uv venv /opt/harness/venv && uv pip install '/opt/harness/src[anthropic,mcp]'
mcp_config_path: /harness-state/hermes/config.yaml#mcp_servers.world (appended at serve start: url HE_WORLD_MCP_URL, headers.Authorization: Bearer HE_WORLD_MCP_TOKEN; tools register as mcp__world__<tool>; the image installs the `mcp` extra so the client SDK is present)
multi_user_mode: CLI with one named session per conversation (dm:<member>, channel:<id>) in one HERMES_HOME; the gateway and its per-user sessions are not used

serve.session_key: dm:<member> | channel:<id> (session title; hermes chat -c <title> --create-if-missing); :t<thread_ts> appended when TurnRequest.thread_ts is set (a task turn with thread = "new" opens a new session in the same conversation)
serve.shared_between_sessions: whatever Hermes's own memory shares across sessions; not configured by the adapter
serve.reply_source: stream-json terminal `result` record (text, exit_code, error, tokens)
serve.exit_mapping: hermes exit 0 -> 0; outer timeout -> 124; proxy refusal, Anthropic SDK error class or HTTP status on stderr or in the result -> 3; else 2

gbrain_mcp: with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL and HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN set at serve start, an mcp_servers.gbrain block (url, headers.Authorization: Bearer <token>, timeout 120, connect_timeout 60) is appended beside world in /harness-state/hermes/config.yaml; tools register as mcp__gbrain__<tool>; `hermes mcp list` is logged. Unset, the config is byte-identical to a cell without gbrain

gbrain_install.variables: HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL=gbrain-docs with HE_GBRAIN_SPLIT (dev | heldout) and HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL_DIR (/he-gbrain-install, the exported view mounted read-only by the runner); the install ladder's docs rungs (docs/gbrain-arm.md)
source_commands: gbrain skillpack scaffold --all --workspace /workspace (gbrain INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md step 5, 'cd <workspace> && gbrain skillpack scaffold --all'; the workspace is explicit because the cd form does not resolve an empty directory at the pin)

gbrain compile-context --target hermes --include-core --out .hermes.md against the split's bot-visible brain (gbrain docs/mcp/HERMES.md 'Always-loaded core memory': the project context file Hermes reads; the docs write it at the git root, which for a trial workspace with no repository is the cwd)
gbrain_install.applied_by: adapter.sh before the harness is prepared (before the world-MCP wiring and ready): the manifest must name this harness and HE_GBRAIN_SPLIT and its view_digest must match its file list; every listed file is checked against its sha256, copied from <view>/workspace/<x> to /workspace/<x> (skills/ at this commit, 64 skills in 127 files) and <view>/.hermes.md to /workspace/.hermes.md (dev 18 pages, held-out 25) and checked again; an existing destination is refused as skillpack scaffold refuses to overwrite
gbrain_install.record: $HE_LOG_DIR/gbrain-install.json (status, code, harness, split, dir, view_digest, files, destinations, copied, error) and ready.gbrain_install {status, files, view_digest, destinations}; ready.adapter_sha256 is the sha256 of the adapter file that ran
gbrain_install.failure: HE-ADAPTER-006, exit 2 before ready, the code and reason in gbrain-install.json and adapter.log

loaded_by_harness..hermes.md: yes: Hermes v2026.9.24 agent/prompt_builder.py build_context_files_prompt (lines 1733-1759) loads one project context file, first match wins, .hermes.md/HERMES.md before AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules; _find_hermes_md (lines 139-148) looks in the cwd and, only inside a git repository, its parents up to the root, so in /workspace (no repository) it reads /workspace/.hermes.md exactly. The cwd is terminal.cwd from config/config.yaml (/workspace) through agent/runtime_cwd.py resolve_context_cwd (line 105), else the process cwd, and the adapter runs hermes from /workspace. The content is injection-scanned (_scan_context_content, line 81: a match blocks the file) and capped by context_file_max_chars (hermes_cli/config_defaults.py line 498, null scales with the context window, floor 20K chars). hermes chat does not set skip_context_files (only --ignore-rules does, hermes_cli/main.py line 1822). Observed keylessly in the image after the install: build_context_files_prompt(cwd='/workspace') returns '# Project Context' with a '## .hermes.md' section holding every kept page heading of the dev view, 2889 chars, nothing blocked (tests/adapter-install.test.ts)
loaded_by_harness.skills: no: Hermes reads skills from HERMES_HOME/skills (/harness-state/hermes/skills; hermes_constants.py get_skills_dir, line 1473), skills.external_dirs (agent/skill_utils.py get_external_skills_dirs, line 359) and, for a project, only <git root>/.hermes/skills or <git root>/.agents/skills when that root is in skills.trusted_project_dirs (agent/skill_utils.py lines 431-437, _candidate_project_skills_dirs line 495 and get_project_skills_dirs line 517; get_all_skills_dirs, line 420, excludes project dirs). /workspace/skills is none of these and /workspace has no git root, so the scaffolded skills are copied as documented and not loaded. Observed keylessly: get_all_skills_dirs() is ['/harness-state/hermes/skills'] and get_project_skills_dirs() is [] with the skills in place (tests/adapter-install.test.ts)

gbrain_install.unset: with HE_GBRAIN_INSTALL unset nothing of this runs; the only difference from a cell without it is the adapter_sha256 field every ready file now carries
